Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27 - Complete Details

Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Login – Fresh Candidate : Intermediate | Other Then Intermediate
  • Login – Renewal Candidates : Intermediate | Other Then Intermediate

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
